Fresh read-only preflight SSH rc0 and PASS. One-shot launcher rc1 at host_identity because three known_hosts algorithms were present; no START, launcher SSH, remote write, graph, device, container or namespace action.

causal_finding: The launcher checked len(all matching host rows) == 1 before filtering by ssh-ed25519. Additional RSA and ECDSA rows caused a local false rejection even though the read-only preflight used a pinned ed25519 SSH route. The failure was before START, so it gives no remote staging or graph evidence.

single_change.name: Local host identity fixture before one-shot release
single_change.smallest_trial: Use a temporary local known_hosts fixture and the exact proposed launcher host_identity logic. Positive case: one pinned ed25519 row plus RSA/ECDSA rows for the same endpoint passes. Negative cases: missing, malformed, duplicated or wrong-fingerprint ed25519 row fails. Assert no START file and no SSH subprocess beyond local ssh -G; capture fixture rc and exact launcher digest before root release.
single_change.falsifier: Any positive case fails, any negative case passes, a network SSH occurs, or the tested launcher digest differs from the release packet.
single_change.stop_condition: Do not release that packet if a case fails or if the fixture cannot run without remote access; retain v2 terminal failure and require a newly reviewed generation.
single_change.expected_effect: Catch this specific multi-algorithm known_hosts mismatch before consuming a one-shot Stage4 release; no claim of graph progress or general security correctness.
single_change.state: proposed_only; no fixture run in this reflection
